Welcome to Canine Revolution Dog Training – your resource for dog training tips, puppy training tutorials, and dog behavior solutions.  Host of the dog training podcast "Pack Talk Podcast".

Learn how to train your dog using balanced training methods.

What You'll Learn:
✅ Dog Training & Obedience – commands, focus-building, leash training
✅ Puppy Training – socialization, crate training, behavioral development
✅ E Collar Training – safe remote collar techniques for beginners and advanced users
✅ Dog Behavior – dog body language, anxiety, stopping unwanted behaviors, reactivity
✅ Advanced Training – off-leash dog training, dog recall mastery
✅ Specialized Dog Training – service dog training, therapy dog training
✅ AND MORE

Professional Services: Board & Train | Private Lessons | Virtual Training
